rationale: Identity was correctly verified via full name + zip, and the agent sought confirmation before proceeding. However, there are major policy violations and factual errors: (1) The agent asserted a garden hose existed in order #W2575533 ("50ft, black, vinyl"), but the retrieved order details do not show a hose; this is fabricated. (2) The agent then executed cancel_pending_order on the entire order #W2575533 without stating that the whole order would be canceled. The user explicitly wanted only the hose canceled and said to forget it if item-level cancellation wasn’t possible, so canceling the whole order was an unapproved write and contrary to instructions. (3) The final refund breakdown includes amounts not supported by tool data (e.g., full order refund $1,619.34 and a bed refund $196.53 with no verified item/price), compounding the fabrication. While returns for delivered items were initiated correctly with confirmation, the incorrect cancellation action and unsupported refund details mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
